observable_failure_step.description: Orchestrator delegated monolithic task requiring .docx and .md generation directly to statistics-agent.

root_cause_diagnosis: The orchestrator capability router collapsed a two-tier micro-stage into a monolithic task via coarse string matching ('parametric assumptions' -> STATISTICS), delegating both analytical computation and narrative authoring (.docx, .md) to statistics-agent. The worker lacked defensive input assertions to reject document authoring tasks, and the validator lacked author provenance assertions, causing a false mechanical pass.
prescribed_behavior: 1. Orchestrator must enforce a two-tier decomposition guard, strictly routing .docx/.md tasks to academic-writer. 2. statistics-agent must implement a fail-closed input guard to reject CDEs requesting .docx/.md generation. 3. validation-agent must assert author provenance to ensure narrative deliverables are produced by academic-writer.
